documents.title: Reglamento del Régimen de Tributación Simplificada
documents.notes: Normative source of the RTS (issue #108). Derogates Decreto 25514-H (1996); SINALEVI vigente text is consolidated with reform 45209-H (vigente 2025-10-13), which widened the activity list from 14 to 22. Key facts: artículo 1 is a CLOSED list of 22 eligible activities — software development and professional services are not among them — and artículo 2 bars entry to anyone carrying on activities outside it; artículo 3 carries the entry thresholds (≤186 salarios base annual purchases, ≤6 people (≤5 for SIEC/Pympa-registered MIPYMES per Ley 10512), a single establishment, ≤350 salarios base fixed assets). Replaces the former `rts-requisitos` Hacienda flyer, whose PDF extraction was column-interleaved layout noise and whose ≤5-employee figure this decree supersedes. idFichaNorma provenance: SINALEVI/SCIJ search → nValor2 98767 (SPEC §3 bridge), content-verified against the 43881-H text before ingestion.
